list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sources: Trophy names, descriptions and grades: the official list on Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/). Progress targets: PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). The guides are this app's own writing, from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing separate to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: the story first, then the people of Leonida, the collectibles, the long counts and the free-roam clean-up, finishing with the 100% completion audit (A Long Road). If the platinum does not pop, the missing trophy is almost always a counted one sitting a few short of its target; the checklist's counters show which.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story — the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which the game starts with. Play through the opening beats until the mission-complete banner lands; the trophy pops with it. It cannot be missed: the campaign cannot advance past it, and it is earned inside the first sitting of any playthrough.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story — finish Chapter 1, the first full chapter after the opening. Follow the story markers through the chapter's missions; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Nothing in the chapter is optional for progression, so no side content is required — just keep the story moving.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story — finish Chapter 2. As with Chapter 1, this is a pure progression trophy: complete the chapter's story missions in order and it pops at the chapter break. Keep a rolling spare save anyway — two of the list's one-chance moments (see the Missables page) sit in the early game, even though this trophy itself cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story — finish Chapter 3. Progression only: work the chapter's missions as they unlock. By now the map and most activity types are open, so it is worth banking early progress on the long counts (stunts, range challenges, WAiNK spots) between story beats — progress made here is progress you do not have to farm later.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story — finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Complete its story missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter close. Before pushing into the final mission, sweep up any stranger strands and collectibles you have unlocked — the finale is a natural point of no return in games of this kind, and a spare save is cheap insurance.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, gold — complete the final mission, the campaign's last story beat; the trophy pops with the ending. Save in a separate slot before you start it: afterwards you return to free roam for the clean-up, and if any one-chance moment is still open (Catch Me If You Can above all), you want a way back to before the point of no return.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story — complete the mission Breakfast Run, one of the named story missions inside the chapters. Follow the story markers and finish it. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is earned by completion alone — no rating, time or style condition is named in the description.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story — complete The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big set-piece robbery. Follow the heist's setup and execution beats as the story presents them; the trophy is for finishing the mission, not for any particular take or escape condition. If a choice of approach is offered, either path earns it.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story — complete the mission Child's Play. A named story mission; play it through to its end and the trophy pops on completion. No optional objective is named in the description, so a straightforward run-through is enough.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story — complete the mission Headliners. Play the named story mission to completion when it unlocks in the campaign. As with the other mission trophies, completion is the whole requirement.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story — complete VCIA Takedown, the airport storyline mission. Play it through — but read Catch Me If You Can before you do: that trophy's unscheduled departure at VCIA appears to live inside this same airport beat, so treat this mission as its likely window and look for the chance to slip away mid-mission rather than after it.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story — complete Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission; finish it when the campaign offers it. Completion alone earns the trophy.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold — attain 100% completion on the game's own tally. This is the audit trophy: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and feats all feed the percentage, so it normally lands last or near-last. When you stall in the high nineties, compare the in-game completion list against this checklist category by category — the gap is usually one strand, one collectible set or one activity type (see Master of None) rather than a grind.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver — complete 250 stunts: the game's stunt jumps and stunt events, counted across the map. The habit to build is banking them as you travel: whenever a ramp or a stunt marker is on your route, take it, instead of saving all 250 for one farm at the end. Stunts are repeatable in free roam and none are tied to the story, so this is a patience trophy, not a missable one. The counter tracks completions.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 250). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 activity types the game offers: races, range challenges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest as they unlock. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win. Work down the activity icons on the map and tick the types off in the counter; the last type is usually the one that unlocks latest in the story.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver — earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the list's marksmanship test: learn each weapon class's challenge on its own terms, accuracy first and speed second — a controlled silver repeated teaches the pattern that turns into gold. Ranges stay open in free roam and challenges can be retried freely, so nothing here is missable. Use the counter to track golds won, not attempts made.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the count of 42 challenges). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 of them across Leonida. A win at each location is what counts, not a time: learn a course with a sighting run, then race it clean. New locations unlock as the map opens up, so sweep them region by region and tick each one off in the counter.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the count of 14 locations). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the operative word: the same race won twice counts once. Work across the race series and vehicle classes rather than repeating a favourite, and tick each distinct win in the counter. Races stay available in free roam, so this pairs naturally with the exploration trophies.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 20). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the game's fishing contact; take his challenge when it is offered and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. If the first attempt goes badly, the challenge can be retaken — the trophy is for winning once, not for winning first time.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one full game on any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Cabinets sit in the game's bars and arcades; pick the shortest game on offer, play it to its end rather than quitting out, and the trophy pops on completion. Any cabinet counts, and it also ticks the arcade type for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, closing his strand. Work Andy's missions whenever they appear until the strand's last one is offered, then finish it. Contact strands can sit dormant until you visit or call, so if Andy goes quiet, check the map for his marker before assuming the strand is done. Finished strands are also what Strangers & Freaks counts.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, closing his strand. Follow Kenton's jobs to the last one and finish it; the trophy pops with the strand's end. As with the other contacts, a quiet map marker usually means the next mission wants a visit or a particular time of day, not that the strand is over.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, closing his strand. Play Billy's missions through to the final one. If his strand stalls, progress the story a beat or return at a different hour — strands in this series often gate their next step on time or story progress rather than ending.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver — complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a stranger's whole chain, not a single job: the trophy counts strands finished, so it takes eight strangers seen through to their final missions. The named contacts — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of the natural eight. The counter tracks strands completed, and the map's stranger markers are the hunting ground.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 8). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, closing his strand. Randy's jobs are the supply runs of the set; finish the chain to its last mission. Keep at it whenever his marker is up — strands only count, for trophies like Strangers & Freaks, once they are finished.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, closing his strand. Play Tyrone's missions through to the end of the chain; the trophy pops on the final mission's completion, and the finished strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in the game's quiet places: viewpoints, shorelines and hilltops. Visit each spot and use the meditate prompt; a spot counts once, and the counter tracks the set. These pair with The Goodtime State: most spots sit in areas you would explore anyway, so route them together.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the count of 18 spots). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's job is a one-off hunt: take his commission, track the named animal — the game will point you at its ground — and bring it down. Unique hunts in this series are staged encounters rather than random spawns, so if the trail goes cold, re-read the job's prompt and return to the marked area instead of ranging the whole map.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver — complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida and gathered into themed sets; a set counts when every card in it is collected. Three full sets is the ask, so pick the sets whose cards cluster in regions you are already sweeping for WAiNK spots and meditation points, and let the counter track sets rather than loose cards.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 3). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver — WAiNK It at 100 locations: the game's photo-spot ritual, performed at marked spots around the state. Each location counts once, and 100 is too many to hold in your head — the counter is the tool. Spots are spread through every region, so this trophy is the backbone of a full-map sweep alongside meditation spots and card sets.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 100). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's challenge list of rolling feats and trials. Fifty is a breadth ask, not a depth one: most challenges complete themselves in ordinary play if you vary what you do. When you stall, read the challenge list; the last few are usually a type you have been ignoring. The counter tracks the total.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 50). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you — a short robbery spree does it — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain. Both halves matter: your partner must be with you, and the level must be lost by escaping, not by being caught. It is a free-roam feat; retry as often as needed.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one wanted run — rob, move, rob — keeping the stars alive between shops; if the wanted level fully drains, the chain resets. Pick a district where three shops sit close, keep your partner with you throughout, and use the counter for the chain.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get behind the wheel of 100 different vehicles so the game registers them. Traffic variety does the work: rich districts, docks, airfields and farms each spawn different sets. Steal broadly rather than deeply and let the counter run; most players land this simply by never refusing a new vehicle in the first half of the game.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 100). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the game's slow-time combat state. Trigger it in a crowd, not a duel: a gang operation or a busy shootout gives you the density. Line up five targets before you activate, then work nearest to farthest while the meter lasts. If a use ends at three or four, reposition to a bigger group rather than forcing it.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport outside the script, during the airport storyline. This is one of the list's one-chance moments: the description names a single act at a single place, and the VCIA Takedown mission (Hi-Jacked) is its natural window. When that mission runs, watch for the chance to slip away — an aircraft, a service exit — rather than following the marker to the end. Keep a save from before the mission until this pops.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: “Kinda hot in these Rhinos” — deal with the Rhinos, the game's tanks, when they roll out against you at high wanted levels or in set-piece fights. The description jokes about its own vagueness; the working reading is that engaging a Rhino and coming through the fight is the trigger. When one appears, stay for it instead of fleeing, and work at range with heavy weapons and cover.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly — no wanted level, no alarm — empty it and leave unseen. The condition is the detection, not the take: if a witness or an alarm trips, walk away and try another store on another day rather than forcing the same one. A quiet approach and an exit route planned before you start are the whole method.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver — rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the heavy robberies: crack the vault, take the money, and get clear — the escape is part of the requirement, so plan the getaway before the vault, not after it. Five separate vaults; the counter tracks clean getaways, and a robbery that ends in arrest does not count.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 5). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes in free roam: stop one — block it, or take its rear doors — take the cash, and lose the response. The escape matters: the trophy completes when you are clear, not when the truck opens. Trucks respawn on their routes, so a failed attempt costs nothing but time.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the state uncovered on the map. Exploration registers by entering an area, so this is a travel trophy: work the map region by region and pair it with the collectible sweeps (WAiNK spots, cards, meditation) that send you to the same corners. The last few areas are always the small islands and the far keys, so save a boat or a plane for the end.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the count of 52 areas). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, one operation each. Gang operations are marked by their owners; hitting any one operation of a gang ticks that gang off. The counter tracks gangs, not operations, so variety is the method: when a new gang's territory opens, rob one of theirs before settling into repeats.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the count of 9 gangs). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a single scene on the Ocean Beach frontage. The description pins the place but not the moment: scenes worded like this usually hang on one spot (a beachfront bar) and possibly one time of day. It is flagged as a one-chance moment out of caution: if it has not popped in ordinary play, keep an early save and work the Ocean Beach bars before the finale.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car out through the showroom's glass. Find a vehicle showroom with a car inside, get into the car, and leave through the window rather than the door. It is a set-piece the game stages in a few places; if one showroom's car will not start the scene, try another showroom rather than the street outside.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play bowling at that named alley. The name is the location: find the Kolt & Associates alley, start a game, and bowl your frames with a follow-through. Any completed game at that alley should do it, and bowling also ticks one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: “A partnership with mass appeal” — one of the list's deliberately vague descriptions, attached to your partnership: the working reading is a milestone reached with your partner, whose shared ventures are the game's spine. We have not pinned its exact trigger down and will not invent one: play the partner content — joint jobs, shared businesses, the pair's scenes — and expect it to pop in ordinary partnered play rather than from a single trick.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: “Choices made (for better or worse)” — PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one, so it is a volume trophy over the game's choice points: dialogue choices, approach choices, decisions in missions and in free roam. Five hundred is built to accumulate across a full playthrough rather than be farmed in one place. Make choices deliberately instead of skipping prompts, and let the counter show the pace.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade) and PSNProfiles' GTA VI trophy page (the progress target of 500). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: “Second time's the charm” — succeed at something on the second try, after failing it once. Which attempt it is attached to is not yet pinned down, and that is exactly why it is flagged: it reads as a fail-then-succeed pair at a single offered event. Until the community identifies it, treat singular first tries — a stranger's request, a unique challenge — with care, and when you do fail something small, retry it at once; the pair may need to be back-to-back.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: “What the hell just happened?” — witness something strange: one of the game's odd encounters out in Leonida. Descriptions this vague are earned by stumbling on the staged weirdness the world hides; this series loves its swamp lights and odd strangers. We will not invent a location: explore off the roads, at night, and when the game shows you something inexplicable, stay and watch it play out — leaving early is the only way to miss it.
trophies.sources: Sources: the official GTA VI trophy list on Exophase (name, description and grade). The guide is our own advice, worked out from the official description; it has not yet been verified in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock a person down by striking them from a moving vehicle with a melee attack. Line it up at low speed: ride or drive alongside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the knockdown is the trophy. A motorcycle makes the geometry easiest. It needs neither a wanted level nor a kill — contact at drive-by pace is the whole trick.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; laundering runs them through your contacts at a cut. This is a money-flow trophy: keep feeding bills to the laundering route instead of spending them raw, and the counter tracks the laundered total. It pairs with the robbery set — every vault and truck raises the pile waiting to be cleaned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services: everything counts, in every shop in the game. It accumulates naturally if you actually use the shops instead of hoarding; the garage purchases of Little Boxes and the robbery upkeep feed it. The counter tracks total spend, so there is nothing to aim at but the shops themselves.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them across Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money at their for-sale signs; the ask is owning every one, so this is partly a money trophy, and the laundering and robbery income is what funds it. Buy them as new regions unlock and let the counter track the set.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — bring vehicles to the game's vehicle-registration service and register them, ten in all. Registration is quick once you know the route: bring a vehicle, register it, repeat with nine more. The vehicles you discover for Whip It Good are the natural candidates, so the two trophies share their hunting.
